piece.headline: Jackson makes Kartik king of the week while the herd sulks
piece.standfirst: Haaland let down 76 armbands. Kartik won the week, and Rajat Arora stays top.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora stretched the lead to 18 over Neol. The captaincy herd, 76 strong, backed Haaland and got 4 each. Kartik won the week with a Jackson armband. Up top, the table barely moved.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Swapnil left 26 points on the bench. The wrong XI cost him a monster week, and he still moved up 5 places. Imagine the rest.
piece.one_to_watch: Prathap and Cherag are 2 points apart on the Big prizes line. One good captain pick could decide who sits above it next week. Neither can afford another bench blunder.

winners.name: Kartik
winners.verdict: Brought in Jackson, then gave him the armband. He returned 22 points. That is nerve and timing, and it won him the week.

winners.name: Sahil
winners.verdict: Signed Vuskovic the week he scored 12 and jumped 23 places. Good timing, and the Arnav sale next door makes it sweeter.

winners.name: Sidharth
winners.verdict: Put the armband on Gabriel and it paid 16. Up 26 places is the biggest leap in the league. Sensible, and it worked.

losers.name: Janit
losers.verdict: A rough week, and the lowest score in the league. Nothing silly to point to. Shake it off and go again.

losers.name: Vivek
losers.verdict: Left 13 points on the bench, and 92nd is where that left him. The wrong 11, picked with confidence.

losers.name: Hardik
losers.verdict: Down 23 places in one week is a proper tumble. Quiet picks, loud consequences. Time to rebuild.
